descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
About Silicon Spirit 
 Silicon Spirit is a design and development studio that partners with organisations across Europe and the Americas to solve complex business challenges through user-centred products. Our clients range from ambitious startups to large players in the financial and eCommerce industry. We move fast, ship real product, and care deeply about craft.
 Role Description 
 We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join our internal development team. This is not a support role and it is not a learn-on-the-job role. You'll be the engineer carrying projects from architecture through production release, often alongside the creative director and the project manager as a technical partner, not under close supervision.
 This is a hands-on role with a hybrid work arrangement allowing up to 4 days remote work.
 Required qualifications 
6-8 years in full stack engineering roles, with a track record of owning production systems and working with fast-moving teams
Advanced proficiency in TypeScript across the stack: React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js on the back end
Strong command of relational data modelling, PostgreSQL, and API design (REST and GraphQL)
 Demonstrated ability to turn Figma designs into accurate, responsive, accessible interfaces without a designer checking every screen 
Experience building and maintaining third-party integrations: payment gateways, ERPs, webhooks, and data sync between systems
Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP), CI/CD, monitoring, and application security fundamentals
A GitHub profile or live products showing at least 3 systems you built or led, with a clear account of your part in each
Fluent, client-ready communication in English and Romanian
Experience planning and delegating work: You know how to break a project down into estimable tasks, hand off clearly, and review code without micromanaging
Demonstrated fluency with agentic AI coding tools in a real engineering workflow: You use them to move faster and lift the quality of your output, not as a novelty
Self-directed work ethic and the judgment to make and defend technical decisions
 Preferred qualifications: 
Experience with Shopify or Shopify Plus: Liquid themes, custom apps, Admin and Storefront APIs
Experience with B2B/SaaS platforms or the retail/eCommerce sector
Experience working directly with international (especially US) clients
Experience building LLM-powered features, MCP servers, or automation workflows (n8n or similar)
Familiarity with React Native or other mobile frameworks
Experience building fully responsive web interfaces
 What you'll own 
Build front ends that match the design to the pixel and hold up under real traffic
Design and build APIs and integrations between client systems such as storefronts, ERPs, PIMs, and analytics
Set and uphold engineering standards: code review, testing, documentation, and release process
Present and defend technical decisions directly to clients and stakeholders
Collaborate closely with design from the first wireframe to ensure what is designed can be built, and what is built matches the design
Use agentic AI tools to accelerate your work, from scoping and scaffolding to implementation, testing, and documentation
Manage your own timelines, milestones, and deliverables with minimal oversight
 What we offer: 
 Compensation & Benefits:
Competitive salary: 12000 - 15000 RON net/month (commensurate with experience)
Performance-based bonuses tied to project outcomes
Premium medical subscription
Life-insurance plan
Latest generation MacBook Pro
Co-working subscription at any worldwide Spaces/Regus location
Hybrid work model: 4 days remote, 1 day in office
Structured workflow with clear tasks, milestones, and daily syncs
Direct exposure to international and US-facing projects across diverse industries
Conference attendance and professional development budget
 Application Process: 
 We value proactive thinkers, team collaboration, and engineers who care deeply about their craft. Interested candidates should submit:
Their CV or LinkedIn profile (via LinkedIn easy-apply)
A GitHub profile or links to live products ( must include at least 3 systems you built or led , with a short note on your role in each)
 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for initial interviews.
